models.architecture_or_algorithm: WeightedEnsemble_L3 using AutoGluon, with 94 manually engineered features (tilt angle, hydrophobic moment, amphiphilicity, net charge, amino acid composition, secondary structure, etc.)
models.input_features: 94 features: tilt angle, angle subtended by hydrophobic residues, propensity to in vitro aggregation, amphiphilicity, hydrophobicity, net charge, amino acid composition, secondary structure, and others
models.candidate_reason: ML model for predicting AMP activity levels with available code and data; suitable for benchmarking feature-based AMP classifiers.
models.representative_reason: Represents traditional ML approach with handcrafted peptide features; model is reproducible from code and representative of feature-based AMP classifiers.
